scope: Offline production DeviceClient plus executePhonePlan; each finite synthetic HTTPS request advances a fake monotonic clock by 1000 or 1300 ms; no real waits, network, serial, firmware or user data
implementation: Default cache floor750ms, successful request RTT high-water x5, maximum5000ms; explicit cacheMs overrides remain fixed. No state checks or server fences removed.

tests.includes: DeviceClient, plan, device-runtime, unchanged independent R1 and R2 regressions

limitations: Plans begin after credential restoration, clock synchronization and lease claim; cold setup time is excluded from the plan wall-clock measurements.

The synthetic board returns a positive terminal HID receipt on segment submission; this is a metadata/cache integration test, not a simulation of firmware scheduler, async result polling or physical gesture latency.
The 2.5s first real TLS handshake, actual TLS RAM pressure and browser background scheduling are not modeled.
A 5s cache does not independently prove current board state; explicit refresh, exact boot/lease scope and board-side fencing remain necessary.
